sections.title: Machine Learning Applications for Seattle Organizations
sections.description: Custom ML models for Seattle's leading industries — eCommerce, technology, aerospace, and healthcare.

blocks.heading: eCommerce and Product ML
paragraphs: Amazon is headquartered in Seattle and has shaped the eCommerce ML expectations of every technology company in the Puget Sound region. ClickMasters builds for the Amazon-adjacent market:

Product recommendation: Collaborative filtering and two-tower neural retrieval for Seattle's eCommerce companies — implementing the same algorithmic approaches that Amazon pioneered, scaled appropriately to non-Amazon product catalogs.
Search relevance: Learning-to-rank ML for eCommerce search — balancing textual relevance, sales signal, and business rules for Seattle's online retail companies.
Demand forecasting: ML time-series forecasting for eCommerce inventory planning — incorporating Seattle-specific seasonality, product lifecycle signals, and promotional effects.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Technology Company Product ML
paragraphs: Microsoft (Redmond), Amazon, T-Mobile (Bellevue), Zillow, Expedia, and Seattle's technology employer community. ML embedded in technology products:
Churn and engagement prediction: SaaS subscription retention ML for Seattle's cloud and enterprise software companies — Microsoft Teams, Expedia booking, T-Mobile subscriber analytics.
Pricing optimization: ML for dynamic pricing at Seattle's marketplace and subscription companies — optimal pricing incorporating demand elasticity, competitive signals, and customer segment context.
Fraud and trust ML: Marketplace trust and safety ML for Seattle's two-sided marketplace companies — detecting fraudulent listings, sellers, and transactions.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Aerospace Manufacturing ML
paragraphs: Boeing (Seattle/Everett, transitioning but historically and operationally significant), Blue Origin (Kent WA), and Seattle's aerospace supply chain:
Composite materials inspection: Computer vision for carbon fiber composite defect detection — crucial for Boeing's composite-intensive aircraft like the 787 and 777X.
Manufacturing process control: ML predicting manufacturing quality from assembly process parameters — drilling, fastening, and surface preparation operations.

Supply chain disruption prediction: ML for Seattle's aerospace supply chain — particularly relevant given Boeing's recent supply chain challenges and the importance of supply disruption prediction for flight rate recovery.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare ML
paragraphs: UW Medicine (University of Washington Medical Center), Providence Health, and Swedish Health. HIPAA-compliant clinical ML:
Patient risk stratification and clinical deterioration early warning for UW Medicine's Epic-based systems.
Clinical research ML for UW's large NIH-funded research programs.
CCPA-analog (Washington My Health MY Data Act) compliant consumer health analytics for Seattle's digital health companies.
Cost: $60,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | HIPAA, WA My Health MY Data Act
